name: performance

findings.message: In the dispatch-unit loop, `resume_mode` is never cleared after the interrupted stage is found and dispatched, so `get_state_field` (which calls `validate_json` → jq + a second jq field read = 2 subprocesses) fires for every remaining dispatch unit in the loop, even though those subsequent stages cannot be `complete`; for a pipeline with n stages after the interruption point this spawns O(2n) unnecessary jq processes on the hot path.
findings.quote:
if $resume_mode && [[ -z "$skip_until_stage" ]]; then
                        local _du_stage_status
                        # Sanitize stage id to prevent jq injection via template-sourced values.
                        local _safe_ust="${_ust//[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/}"
                        _du_stage_status="$(get_state_field "$state_file" \
                            ".stage_statuses[\"$_safe_ust\"]" '' 2>/dev/null || true)"

reason: the performance lens found no medium or high or critical problem the change introduced that fails it
